## Before submitting

For non-trivial changes, please open an issue and agree on the approach first.

List browser versions, pages and any additional scenarios you verified.

## Permissions and privacy

Does this change permissions, host access, stored data, redirects, messages across origins or store disclosure text? If yes, explain why and update the relevant documentation.
